question: Famous classical dancer Vidyagauri Adkar is recognised with ________ Gharana of Indian classical dance form.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vidyagauri Adkar **is a **Kathak dance exponent **from **Mumbai**. She **specializes **and performs in **Jaipur Gharana of Kathak**.
 
• She has **performed **in many elite cultural events** **and music & dance festivals across India. **Chilanka Dance Festival **in **Thiruvananthapuram**, **Festival of Dance **and **Music Delhi**, **Khajuraho Festival of Dances**, **Kathak Prabha **– **Festival of India in South Africa**, **Kathak Mahotsava 2012**, **Delhi**, "**Anvarat" Kathak performance**, etc.
 
• She is associated with live performances** **for the **past 10 years **and is one of the **promising young Kathak dancers of to** [IMAGE: https://www.veethi.com/images/people/profile/_Vidyagauri_Adkar.jpeg] ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak **is one of the **eight **major forms of **Indian classical dance**. It is the **classical dance **form of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The **origin of Kathak **is **t**raditionally attributed** **to the traveling bards** **in of ancient northern India** **known as **Kathakars **or **storytellers**.
 
• The **Lucknow Gharana of Kathak **was founded by** Ishwari Prasad**, a devotee of the **Bhakti movement**.
